title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and update actions/deps
author: Ava Martinez
ci_status: pass (some checks initially failed, rerun green)
release_notes: Consolidate GitHub Actions workflows for lint/test/release into a smaller matrix to reduce CI minutes and simplify caching. Bump critical GH Actions and node toolchain used by JS/TS SDKs. No runtime changes to product code.
description: Motivation: CI runtime and maintenance overhead have grown as we added repo-specific workflows and ad-hoc action versions. This PR consolidates lint, test, and release workflows into a smaller set of reusable jobs, standardizes Node versions, and updates actions/dependencies to address flaky cache restores and long queue times. Changes include: consolidated .github/workflows/lint.yml and test.yml into .github/workflows/ci.yml; extracted reusable composite actions into .github/actions/ci-helpers; standardized node matrix to [18,20] with a single test matrix for SDK packages; improved caches with deterministic keys and parallel restore/fallback; updated release automation to the latest release-action and added guardrails for draft-release creation. Checklist: - [x] consolidate workflows and remove duplicates - [x] bump actions and pinned versions - [x] standardize node matrix and test matrix size - [x] fix cache key collisions and add fallback restore - [x] run full CI and verify SDK builds - [x] document workflow changes in dev-infra/README. Related: ENG-4321 (CI modernization), SUP-2104 (support incident: flaky cache restore), previous workflow hygiene PRs (see pr-241321, pr-239876).
commits_summary: chore(ci): add consolidated ci.yml and reusable actions
fix(ci): improve cache restore fallback and key determinism
docs(dev-infra): update README with workflow conventions

Ava Martinez: Reply: Added conditional for native builds on node18 only and left 20 for lint/test to catch syntax differences.
Priya Desai: Can we pin actions to a commit SHA for release-action? Risk appetite for minor releases is high.
Ava Martinez: Updated release-action to a pinned SHA and documented the rationale in dev-infra/README.
Marta Kim: Observability: CI job labels lost some perf metrics, added a small change to re-add job-level tags.
Ava Martinez: Added job-level tags and bumped retention for ci-artifacts to 7 days.
notes_for_ops: Ops: Monitor CI minutes and cache hit/miss ratio for 2 weeks after merge. If cache misses remain high, revert cache key change and open a follow-up to iterate on workspace-level caching.
